tools.name: set_password
tools.description:
Add password protection to an unprotected PDF file.

Creates a NEW job_id (with parent_job_id linking to the source). After the operation
completes, call 'view_pdf' with the new job_id to display the result. Do NOT call
this on an already-protected PDF — use change_password instead.

tools.name: change_password
tools.description:
Change the password of an already-protected PDF file.

Creates a NEW job_id (with parent_job_id linking to the source). After the operation
completes, call 'view_pdf' with the new job_id to display the result. Do NOT call
this on an unprotected PDF — use set_password instead.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: batch_upload_pdf · Private data: compare_pdfs, compress_pdf, delete_pdf_page, set_password, change_password, upload_pdf, batch_upload_pdf, create_upload_page, check_upload_status, view_pdf, get_pdf_page_images · Public sink: upload_pdf, batch_upload_pdf, create_upload_page, check_upload_status · Destructive: delete_pdf_page, list_redactable_line_text, redact_by_text_range, get_pdf_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: batch_upload_pdf · Private data: compare_pdfs, compress_pdf, delete_pdf_page, set_password, change_password, upload_pdf, batch_upload_pdf, create_upload_page, check_upload_status, view_pdf, get_pdf_page_images · Public sink: upload_pdf, batch_upload_pdf, create_upload_page, check_upload_status · Destructive: delete_pdf_page, list_redactable_line_text, redact_by_text_range, get_pdf_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
